title: eBay + Etsy Scraper Pro - Watches, Cards, Sneakers & More
description: Stop slaving over your computer clicking through hundreds of listings. Pay less than a coffee ($0.11 for 30 listings) to save 5+ hours of manual price research. Scrape eBay AND Etsy in one run — the world's two largest consumer marketplaces. Search for ANYTHING: watches, Pokemon cards, sports cards, sneakers, vintage items, antiques. Real prices in USD with median, min, max, and quartile stats. 14 pre-built categories across watches, sports cards, TCG/Pokemon, sneakers, and vintage collectibles. Anti-bot bypass via Bright Data. 98% cheaper than CardLadder ($20/mo). Perfect for collectors, resellers, and price monitoring.
